summary: Youlife Group Inc., a Shanghai-based education services foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on September 30, 2026 disclosing that Ms. Liqun Yao resigned as director and chief financial officer effective that same date, with no cited disagreement over operations, policies or practices. The Board immediately appointed Mr. Haijun Zhang, a 20-year finance veteran and internal deputy general manager of finance since October 2019, as director and acting CFO. No terms, advisors, premiums or ownership changes were disclosed. The filing is incorporated by reference into the company's existing Form F-3 shelf registration. Watch for delayed financial reporting or disclosure-control risk from an internal, untested acting CFO.
